questions.stem: When \(35\) is divided by \(7\), what is the quotient?
When \(47\) is divided by \(5\), what is the remainder?
questions.keySolution:
Division: \(47 \div 5 = 9\) with remainder \(2\)
Quotient \(= 9\), Remainder \(= 2\)
Verification: \(5 \times 9 + 2 = 45 + 2 = 47\) ✓

questions.stem: Find the quotient and remainder when \(98\) is divided by \(13\).
When a number is divided by \(8\), the quotient is \(6\) and remainder is \(5\). What is the number?
questions.keySolution:
Using the formula: Dividend \(=\) Divisor \(\times\) Quotient \(+\) Remainder
Number \(= 8 \times 6 + 5 = 48 + 5 = 53\)
Verification: \(53 \div 8 = 6\) with remainder \(5\) ✓

questions.stem: When \(1000\) is divided by \(17\), what is the remainder?
Find the quotient when \(2348\) is divided by \(23\).
What is the remainder when \(3^{100}\) is divided by \(5\)?
questions.keySolution:
Finding pattern of powers of \(3\) modulo \(5\):
\(3^1 \equiv 3 \pmod{5}\)
\(3^2 \equiv 9 \equiv 4 \pmod{5}\)
\(3^3 \equiv 27 \equiv 2 \pmod{5}\)
\(3^4 \equiv 81 \equiv 1 \pmod{5}\)
Pattern repeats every \(4\) powers. \(100 = 4 \times 25\), so \(3^{100} \equiv 1 \pmod{5}\)
Remainder \(= 1\)

questions.stem: What is the remainder when \(2^{50}\) is divided by \(7\)?
questions.keySolution:
Finding pattern of powers of \(2\) modulo \(7\):
\(2^1 \equiv 2\), \(2^2 \equiv 4\), \(2^3 \equiv 1 \pmod{7}\)
Pattern repeats every \(3\) powers. \(50 = 3 \times 16 + 2\), so \(2^{50} \equiv 2^2 \equiv 4 \pmod{7}\)
Remainder \(= 4\)

A number when divided by \(d\) gives quotient \(q\) and remainder \(r\). If quotient is \(12\), remainder is \(8\), and divisor is \(13\), find the number.
questions.keySolution:
Using: Dividend \(=\) Divisor \(\times\) Quotient \(+\) Remainder
Number \(= 13 \times 12 + 8 = 156 + 8 = 164\)

questions.stem: What is the remainder when \(10^6\) is divided by \(7\)?

When \(N\) is divided by \(6\), remainder is \(5\). What is the remainder when \(3N\) is divided by \(6\)?
What is the remainder when \(123456\) is divided by \(9\)?
questions.keySolution:
A number's remainder when divided by \(9\) equals the remainder of its digit sum divided by \(9\).
Digit sum \(= 1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 6 = 21\)
\(21 \div 9 = 2\) remainder \(3\)
Remainder \(= 3\)

questions.keySolution:

Expressed as: \(N = bq + a\), where \(0 \leq a < b\)

questions.stem: What is the remainder when \(78^{50}\) is divided by \(77\)?
When three numbers \(483\), \(645\), and \(807\) are divided by some number, they leave the same remainder. Find the divisor.
questions.keySolution:
If three numbers leave the same remainder when divided by \(d\), then their differences are divisible by \(d\).
Differences:
\(645 - 483 = 162\)
\(807 - 645 = 162\)
\(807 - 483 = 324\)
GCD\((162, 324) = 162\)
Divisor \(= 162\)
